name: Svelte MCP
description: Gives coding agents the official Svelte documentation and a static-analysis autofixer for generated Svelte code, via a remote MCP server, a local MCP server, or a CLI.

skills.name: Documentation Lookup
skills.description: Lists the available Svelte documentation sections and fetches the full, current text of the requested sections from svelte.dev.

skills.name: Svelte Autofixer
skills.description: Uses static analysis to flag issues in generated Svelte code, and can be called in a loop until every suggestion is resolved.

skills.name: Playground Link
skills.description: Generates an ephemeral Svelte playground link that holds the generated code, so a solution can be tested without writing files.

skills.name: Svelte Task Prompt
skills.description: Provides a prompt that tells the model which doc sections exist, which tools to call and when, and how to read their results.

skills.name: Doc Section Resources
skills.description: Exposes every Svelte documentation section as an MCP resource the user can attach to a session for targeted context.
